profile.legalName: La Clinica De La Raza Inc
profile.summary: La Clínica de La Raza is a nonprofit community health center. It provides medical, dental, vision, behavioral health, pharmacy and other health services, including programs for adolescents, veterans and people with HIV/AIDS. It also runs school-based health centers at several Oakland public schools.
